The '''THORN Crisis Specialist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] employee of [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], stationed in the crisis command center within the [[rakghoul tunnels]] and tasked [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] THORN volunteers with various tasks. Later, he was also stationed in the rakghoul tunnels on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
